summary: Frontend-only test of crosshair styles, opacity slider, loadout panel, operator portrait + quick regression at 1920x900 and 1920x1080. All pass, no page errors. Crosshair defaults to 'cross' (data-crosshair=cross, opacity 0.9); dot/circle/cross buttons switch the data-crosshair attribute and the active button gets the active-cross class. Opacity slider has aria min 10, max 100, default 90; 50 gives value 50 and style opacity 0.5, Home gives 10/0.1, End gives 100/1. The reticle canvas is 220px, close in size to the stasis meter (190x188) and radar (212x176). hud-loadout sits below hud-target-readout and shows slots 1-4: PRIMARY UNASSIGNED (active), SECONDARY UNASSIGNED, EQUIP A EMPTY, EQUIP B EMPTY. With toggle-layer-reticle off, slot-reticle and slot-target are removed and the loadout stays visible. The operator portrait image loads (naturalWidth 1024), the callsign reads AETHER-01, the stasis-index-value overlay shows a number and the brain icon is gone. Presets: calm gives 2 contacts, SCANNING, no throttle, STABLE. Combat gives 4 contacts, TARGET LOCK, throttle shown, DRIFTING with correct JP label. Overload gives 5 contacts, TARGET LOCK, throttle shown, UNSTABLE. Streaming works: backend status showed publishers=1 and frames increasing. The Unreal page loads with its file list and code viewer. Layout at 1920x900: the RIG rail spans y 165-428 and the target readout starts at y 485, with the loadout ending at y 732, so they do not overlap vertically. Both panels stay inside the visor's bottom-right curve.

issues: Loadout panel ends close to the visor's bottom-right curved edge (~70px margin); on shorter viewports it may clip - not tested below 900px height
In overload, the OBSERVER THROTTLE T2 badge next to the RIG rail visually sits near/behind entity E-04 label (entity labels can overlap HUD rail - cosmetic)
Loadout slot names (UNASSIGNED/EMPTY) are very low contrast/tiny - intentional placeholder but barely legible

critical_code_review_comments: Panels.jsx: import statements for CymaticRadar/CompassRose appear after the LoadoutPanel export (line ~27) - works due to hoisting but should be moved to file top for readability
VisorPage.jsx: slot-target uses conditional render for the readout while the loadout always renders - fine, but the loadout is not controlled by any layer toggle (consider adding one)
LissajousReticle: crosshair prop is read inside the canvas loop closure; it works (attribute and redraw verified) but depends on useCanvasLoop picking up the latest draw callback
context_for_next_testing_agent: Radix slider: focus [data-testid=slider-crosshairOpacity] [role=slider] and use Arrow/Home/End keys. The stream switch testid is stream-toggle. The Unreal file list does not use the unreal-file-* testid prefix (the list rendered fine visually). Mobile and tablet were not tested.
